articles.headline: Havertz returning to Arsenal after suffering injury with Germany
articles.description: Kai Havertz is returning to Arsenal to be assessed after suffering an injury in Germany's Nations League clash with Netherlands.

articles.headline: Kai Havertz returns to Arsenal for treatment on hamstring injury
articles.description: Havertz will play no further part in Germany’s Nations League games after suffering a ‘muscle sprain’ in the 1-1 draw with the Netherlands

articles.headline: Arsenal dealt injury blow as Kai Havertz limps off in Germany clash
articles.description: Havertz was chosen to lead the line in Jurgen Klopp’s first match as Germany manager
